ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the attached figure, quadrilateral MNPQ is a parallelogram, M is located at the upper left, N is located at the upper right, P is located at the lower right, Q is located at the lower left; M and N are adjacent vertices, and N and Q are opposite vertices. The angle markings in the figure also show that N and Q are the same type of angle marking, consistent with opposite angles of a parallelogram being equal. Reasoning: The problem gives m∠M = 10x, m∠N = 20x. Adjacent angles of a parallelogram are supplementary, so 10x + 20x = 180, obtaining 30x = 180, x = 6. Therefore m∠N = 20x = 120. Opposite angles of a parallelogram are equal, so ∠Q = ∠N = 120.
